person: Carmen Ruiz is the whole HR department at a 46-person manufacturer, and every offer there is contingent on a background check. She has a handful of candidates at different stages: some rejected on a report, one hired, one who walked away. She keeps a paper calendar of deadlines and does not trust automated reminders. She wants every notice tied to its rule and nothing mailed to a candidate without her approval, and she will check the day counts herself.
stated_up_front: I've got a few candidates whose background checks came back and I need to figure out who is owed a pre-adverse notice and who is ready for the final one. Don't send anything to anyone until I've looked at it, and show me the rule and the dates you're counting from.

facts.about: Company size and role of the person doing this
facts.truth: 46 employees, a machining and assembly plant; Carmen is the only HR person

facts.about: Company wait before a final notice
facts.truth: Five full business days after the pre-adverse notice goes out, written in the hiring policy she wrote with the outside lawyer

facts.about: Candidate owed a first pre-adverse notice
facts.truth: Dale Whitcomb, forklift operator offer, report shows a 2023 felony theft conviction; reason recorded as background report; signed authorization on 29 September
Marisol Pena, press operator, pre-adverse notice with report and summary of rights mailed 1 October; five business days with Columbus Day (12 October) not counted ends well before today

facts.about: Candidate rejected for a non-report reason
facts.truth: Tobias Lindqvist failed the blueprint-reading skills test on 5 October; the report was clear and plays no part
Renee Okafor, shipping clerk, started 12 October after a clear report
Gordon Haile emailed 14 October saying the DUI on his report belongs to another Gordon Haile with a different birth year
Aaliyah Brandt withdrew by email on 8 October to take another job
Checkr's rep emailed offering to send all adverse action notices for a per-notice fee; Carmen has not answered and does not want to
A paper desk calendar, where she writes the pre-adverse send date and the day the wait ends
Her outside employment lawyer, billed by the quarter hour, so she only calls with a real question

unknowns: Whether the law sets a specific number of days for the wait before a final notice
Which exact section of the FCRA requires the summary of rights to be sent with the report
Whether Checkr has already finished reinvestigating Gordon Haile's dispute
What the code on the Checkr report for Dale Whitcomb's record means
